title: SVB Regional Banking Stress (Mar 2023)
description: A deposit run on Silicon Valley Bank spread to other regional banks. Banks and real estate fell; Treasuries, gold and Bitcoin rallied as rate-hike expectations dropped. Shocks are real total returns (Yahoo Finance adjusted close) from 2023-03-08 to 2023-03-17.
source_name: Yahoo Finance (adjusted close); events cited in references
transmission: 2023-03-08: SVB discloses a large securities sale and an emergency $2.25bn stock offering [1]
2023-03-12: Signature Bank closed; Fed creates the Bank Term Funding Program [2]
